adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` path awaits `createEvent` sequentially and only `push`es when `createdEvent` is truthy. However, `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts:createEvent` catches errors and returns `undefined` (not an `EventResult` with `success:false`), including a special-case `404` that also returns `undefined`. This means a failed destination calendar silently disappears from `createdEvents`, so callers receive no per-destination failure result and no reference can be created for that co-host calendar.
